test_find_docker: test the find_docker function that locates the docker or podman CLI binary via PATH, env var, or known install locations
test_find_docker_env_override: test the HERMES_DOCKER_BINARY environment variable override for specifying an alternative container runtime like podman
test_find_docker_caching: test that find_docker caches the resolved docker executable path to avoid repeated discovery lookups
test_find_docker_fallback_podman: test that find_docker falls back to podman when docker is not found on PATH
test_find_docker_macos_search_paths: test that find_docker falls back to known macOS Docker Desktop install paths when docker is not in PATH
